title: Module 3: Constructivism & Active Learning
description: Use constructivist theory, the Zone of Proximal Development, and scaffolding principles to design more active and meaning-rich learning experiences.
learning_objectives: Describe how constructivism changes instructional design decisions.
Explain the role of the Zone of Proximal Development in digital learning support.
Audit a learning activity for active meaning-making and timely scaffolding.
